title: I know that fellow
html_source: Another bawdy joke? A bitter experience of Cockburn?

anchor.prefix:
Dr Forrest, dean of Worcester. Eh? Deaths. Bristow, at Whitehall lane, London: Carr, Stoke Newington, of gastritis and heart disease: Cockburn, at the Moat house, Chepstow... 

 —
anchor.suffix:
, says Joe, from bitter experience. 

1932#268

 — Cockburn. Dimsey, wife of David Dimsey, late of the admiralty: Miller, Tottenham, aged eightyfive: Welsh, June 12, at 35 Canning
